description: This file defines a SkillService class in the OrangeHRM system, which provides methods for managing 'Skill' entities, including saving, retrieving by ID, deleting, and searching skills. It acts as a service layer that interacts with the Data Access Object (DAO) for skills and handles exceptions specific to the application's service logic.

classes.name: SkillService
classes.description: Provides business logic for managing skills within the OrangeHRM system, acting as an intermediary between controllers/UI and the data layer, with exception handling.

methods.name: getSkillDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the SkillDao instance used for data operations.

methods.name: setSkillDao
methods.description: Sets the SkillDao instance, allowing dependency injection.

methods.name: saveSkill
methods.description: Persists a Skill entity to the database via the DAO.

methods.name: getSkillById
methods.description: Retrieves a Skill entity by its identifier.

methods.name: deleteSkills
methods.description: Deletes multiple Skill entities identified by their IDs.

methods.name: searchSkill
methods.description: Performs a search for skills based on filter parameters, handling exceptions and throwing ServiceException on error.

methods.name: getSearchSkillsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of skills matching the search filter, with error handling via ServiceException.
